branch.songTitle: All Thoughts Are Prey to Some Beast
branch.line: Hoppin' around from branch to branch
stanza: The leafless tree looked like a brain
The birds within were all the thoughts and desires within me
Hoppin' around from branch to branch
Or snug in their nests listenin' in

branch.line: And float from branch to branch
stanza: There's bound to be a ghost at the back of your closet
There'll always be a few things, maybe several things
That you're going to find really difficult to forgive
There's gonna come a day when you feel better
You'll rise up free and easy on that day
And float from branch to branch
Just when that day is coming, who can say? Who can say?
